answer: Each agent identity must pass a memory-hard proof-of-compute puzzle whose difficulty doubles per identity from the same hardware fingerprint: 1 fake identity costs ~10 GPU-minutes, 2 cost ~30, n cost ~10·(2ⁿ−1) minutes—exponential scaling—so spawning even a 10-identity ember swarm of falcon-like market bots demands more tundra-cooled compute than the attacker's fleet can burn, with re-verification every 7 days.
